title: Zillow Real Estate & Rentals
description:

The Zillow app puts essential real estate tools and experts at your fingertips, no matter where you are in your home search. Create a personalized plan, save and share homes with your partner in a shared collection, and stay organized every step of the way. Make your home search easier when you set your search filters to search for homes to buy or rent. Check your BuyAbilityΓäá score for an estimate of your home-buying budget based on your finances and current interest rates. 

Find apartments and houses on Zillow using your Zillow Home Loans Verified Pre-approval. See which homes fit your budget, connect with a real estate agent, and take the step with confidence. See more listings than ever before, all in one place, and keep your home search moving forward. Get the app to make it all possible.

Get the app to seamlessly browse potential new houses and apartments.

ZILLOW APP FEATURES:

RENT OR BUY A HOUSE OR APARTMENT

- Check out neighborhood details, including restaurants, school districts and more in your home search.
- Access the pricing and details you need to compare homes & apartments.
- Discover personalized home recommendations, and seamlessly connect with real estate agents.
- Tour homes based on a filtered search. Apply filters for school districts, views, pricing, pets, HOAs, and more to find the perfect match.
- Review personal renter profiles so you can visit a house or apartments. Engage directly with potential landlords and property managers who rent homes.
- Easier co-shopping for homes or apartments: Tag your favorite home features and share your favorites to coordinate your search with a partner or roommate.
- Push notifications let you know when houses come to market, have a sale pending, or drop in price while you are searching for your new home to tour.
